# Browser graphics runtimes

These files are served locally so the avatar also works on a LAN client that
cannot reach a public CDN.

- `pixi.min.js`: PixiJS 6.5.10, MIT license
  - Source: https://github.com/pixijs/pixijs

`pixi.min.js` is the only runtime used by the current Komo 2D puppet.
The following files are retained as unused Live2D reference runtimes:

- `pixi-live2d-cubism4.min.js`: pixi-live2d-display 0.4.0, MIT license
  - Source: https://github.com/guansss/pixi-live2d-display
- `live2dcubismcore.min.js`: Live2D Cubism Core
  - Source and license: https://www.live2d.com/en/sdk/license/

The Live2D model has its own license notice under
`../assets/live2d/mark_ja/ReadMe.txt`.
